chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease secondary to long‑standing type 2 diabetes, currently awaiting kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a 36‑year history of type 2 diabetes diagnosed in 1988, complicated by progressive diabetic nephropathy. Renal function declined sequentially from CKD stage 1 in 1995 to stage 4 by early 2004, with persistent proteinuria and microalbuminuria. Anemia developed in 1994, and diabetic microvascular complications (retinopathy, neuropathy) are present. Metabolic syndrome with hypertriglyceridemia adds cardiovascular risk. The patient also has chronic substance‑use disorders (opioid abuse, alcoholism, daily tobacco smoking) and reports ongoing stress. He is on insulin therapy, vitamin B12, and a nicotine patch, and is listed as awaiting kidney transplantation. Recent vital signs and laboratory data (BP, eGFR, lipids, BMI) are missing, limiting assessment of current control.
